equity.equity_measurement: Convenience sample skewed toward Hispanic and Black youth (peer-leader recruitment); groups other than White, Black and Hispanic are collapsed into Other because of small numbers.

notes: The community-vs-school comparison is described only verbally; its stratification by grade and race/ethnicity is ambiguous in wording. Reasons for smoking bidis are a summary of 280 responses. Pricing, excise taxes and access restrictions appear only as research or policy recommendations.
view_issues: Definitions differ between text and Table 1: current use 'more than one bidi in the last 30 days' vs 'one or more'; heavy 'more than 100' vs '>=100'. Sex counts (342+282=624) leave 18 missing as stated.
